Raw wireless identifiers and precise location never enter persistence or evidence

assumptions: @chenjie1129 is the interim accountable DRI until responsibilities are delegated
Conditional deadlines freeze while their entry gate is blocked

Add an unlicensed sixteenth production entry

claims.statement: The six stages have goals, owners, deadlines, acceptance criteria, transitions, and risk controls.
Stage 1 is complete for host scope and does not claim hardware validation.
Stage 2 can migrate a smaller same-schema catalog by stable species ID and durably upgrade it.
Stages 4-6 remain blocked and no cloud runtime is introduced.

Every risk has severity, owner, trigger, mitigation, affected stages, and status
Host results are not described as firmware or physical-device validation
Smaller current-schema catalog records map by stable ID and omitted records remain UNKNOWN
Catalog-count migration is committed, read back, and not repeatedly migrated
No backend, account, GPS, cloud runtime, or LLM dependency is added
